notes: Parts are unchanged from step 1; the step 1 list matched the image and the parts list (12 LEDs, 12 x 220 ohm resistors, 25 jumper wires, breadboard, Mega).

Each LED anode shares a breadboard column strip with the top end of its resistor. The resistor straddles the centre gap, and the pin 2-13 wire lands on the opposite half of the same column. Each cathode sits in the next column, which a short black jumper ties to the ground rail.

The image is drawn flipped. Its upper rail and rows f-j are taken as the catalogue's 'bn' rail and bank 'b'; the lower rows a-e are bank 't'. Column numbers were estimated from the image, so exact holes may be off by one, but the topology is faithful.
Mega pin 13 feeds the left-most resistor and pin 2 the right-most, as in the image. The ground rail is fed from the Mega GND header pin next to AREF, which is assumed to be GND.1.
The tutorial's schematic shows every LED cathode tied to Mega GND, and the ground rail does this.
